covers: Phase 1/2 prerequisite source and actual extension owners
prohibition on parallel schemas, stores, apps, clients, canonical indexes, and Monaco adapters

draftContract.extensionRule: Extend this single strict Zod owner; do not create a parallel draft schema/versioned store.

apiContract.extensionRule: Extend the shared API Zod owner alongside draft.ts; browser request/response types remain derived here.

draftIdentity.identityRule: Ordered selected base/head full OIDs determine the draft; merge-base is recorded but not key authority.

persistence.serialization: one in-process queue per repository root plus comparison key
persistence.atomicWrite: strict whole-document validation; restrictive sibling wx temp; write/sync/close; rename over canonical; sync directory where supported; cleanup temp on failure
persistence.extensionRule: Put all six Phase 3 mutation operations and expected-revision CAS in this owner. Do not add a second store, queue, writer, or draft pathname.
persistence.existingInvariant: appendComment rejects an occupied exact anchor through DraftConflictError, preserving one accepted comment per anchor.

draftLoading.rule: A raw-byte loader/recovery classifier must sit ahead of normal store mutation; malformed/schema-invalid bytes remain untouched and newer versions remain read-only.

fastify.order: createSessionApp registers session security before registerSessionRoutes and static assets
fastify.extensionRule: Add every draft/reveal/drift route to this one registry and inherit token, Host, and Origin hooks; do not construct another Fastify app or unguarded route plugin.

capabilities.rule: Browser never supplies repository, path, ref, object, comparison key, draft path, anchor facts, or selector authority.

client.extensionRule: Add fixed no-body mutation/reveal/drift client calls here; no alternate HTTP client or URL authority surface.

vueCanonicalState.extensionRule: Evolve this canonical state owner or make an explicitly replacing successor only; never maintain competing comment indices. Every attempted edit/summary buffer remains local across failure/conflict.

reviewSurface.rule: Extend the existing rail/workspace/composer and local primitives; preserve exact-show navigation through workspace commands.

monaco.lifecycle: Adapter owns immutable models, decorations, zones, listeners, hidden-context reveal, and disposal; Vue owns persistence and DOM focus.
monaco.rule: Use show-comment/reveal commands and this adapter only; no second editor adapter, direct Monaco private state, fuzzy relocation, or duplicate zone lifecycle.

git.rule: Use installed Git through fixed argument arrays and the server-retained launch descriptor. No shell interpolation, browser selector input, or current-session comparison refresh.

markdownDeclarations.prohibition: Do not assume markdown-it or @types/markdown-it before the approved artifact and compiler evidence.

revealDraftFile.evidence: Current src routes/client/capability surfaces contain no fixed no-body active-draft reveal action; source search finds only Monaco comment/context reveal operations.
revealDraftFile.requiredBoundary: Fixed active launch-owned draft only, standard token/Host/Origin checks before platform adapter work, no body/query/path authority, safe relative display only.

selectorRelaunch.evidence: No existing authorized fixed no-body new-comparison capability is present in the current app/routes/client. Current Phase 1 session guidance already requires terminal relaunch.
selectorRelaunch.requiredUI: 03-06 must display CLI relaunch guidance and must not invent a callable current-session refresh action.

decisions.D-01: Open-first exact-path groups and collapsed resolved group: workspace-state + CommentGroups + CommentsRail.
decisions.D-02: Show comment uses workspace command sequence and single Monaco adapter exact reveal/focus; never relocates.
decisions.D-03: Inline edit uses independent workspace composer buffer and explicit save through contract/store/client.
decisions.D-04: Hard delete confirmation plus deterministic successor focus belongs in mutation reducer, workspace state, panel, and rail.
decisions.D-05: No tombstones, undo, threads, or replies; mutations remove the canonical record.
decisions.D-06: Resolve/reopen are legal atomic transitions through one store/CAS path.
decisions.D-07: Summary is a persistent top-of-review surface in draft contract, state, API, and SummarySection.
decisions.D-08: One canonical Markdown edit/preview representation; safe preview decision is approval-gated.
decisions.D-09: Explicit save or Cmd/Ctrl+Enter writes the whole draft with expected revision.
decisions.D-10: Every failure retains attempted local buffers; never optimistically replace canonical state.
decisions.D-11: Empty summary is valid canonical state.
decisions.D-12: One whole-draft monotonic revision is owned by contracts and draft-store serialization.
decisions.D-13: Expected-revision CAS returns conflict/latest and writes zero bytes when stale.
decisions.D-14: Reload latest retains attempts; no automatic merge, force write, or retry.
decisions.D-15: Raw malformed/schema-invalid bytes are preserved and read-only until verified backup-first recovery.
decisions.D-16: Recovery makes an identical verified backup before start-fresh replacement.
decisions.D-17: Newer schema bytes remain immutable and expose upgrade guidance only.

requirements.CMT-04: Delete: contract/store/routes/client/workspace state/panel deterministic focus packaged acceptance.
requirements.CMT-05: Resolve/reopen: legal transition reducer/store/CAS/client/grouped UI packaged acceptance.
requirements.CMT-06: Counts/groups/jump: pure grouping, rail, workspace commands, exact Monaco adapter navigation.
requirements.CMT-07: One summary: contract/store/routes/client/canonical state/SummarySection safe preview and CAS.
requirements.DRFT-04: Serialized whole-draft expected-revision CAS with conflict/latest and no stale write.
requirements.DRFT-05: Raw loader/classifier, backup-first recovery, newer read-only state, fixed reveal action.
requirements.DRFT-06: Server-retained selector descriptor, fixed Git runner, secured observation route, read-only warning state.

nonNegotiableProhibitions: No parallel schema/store/app/client/canonical comment index/Monaco adapter.
No browser draft path, repository, selector, OID, ref, worktree, blob, anchor, or comparison authority.
No fuzzy anchor relocation, source mutation, silent comparison refresh, soft delete/undo, threads/replies, automatic merge, or force overwrite.
